name: Zanner Toobin
backstory: Zanner Toobin is a Rock Gnome, first found in the Steel Watch Foundry in Act Three. If the party help to save the kidnapped Gondians in the Iron Throne, he becomes an Attached Follower while progressing through the Foundry.
